build.reason: The recipe selects and links the xinclude target, but no build result is supplied.

input.reason: The entry can read a main URL and XML entity from fuzz bytes and select a positive allocation limit; the parser receives that URL.

lifecycle.reason: For the focused route, the entry creates an XInclude context for a parsed document and has cleanup for the context, document, parser context and fuzz data.

control_flow.reason: The old entry invokes root processing and immediately checks xinc->errNo. On failure of the URL copy, root processing returns before traversal, and the memory reporter does not set that field.

accepted.requirement: Focused candidate o-287f3fca18520291 (g0003, g0044): an injected allocation failure during xmlXIncludeProcessNode must satisfy the old harness’s existing XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY check through xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc), or through another indication already used by that check.
accepted.target_route: Encode a main URL and well-formed XML entity, then select the allocation index for the document URL copy after parsing and XInclude-context creation. The entry passes the document and context to xmlXIncludeProcessNode and checks the context error immediately afterward.
accepted.failure_condition: When the URL copy returns NULL, xmlXIncludeErrMemory calls xmlRaiseMemoryError with a NULL error-object pointer. The XInclude context was zero initialized, so its errNo remains zero; the injected allocator records a failure. xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure therefore aborts on the mismatch.
accepted.alternative_paths: The URL-copy failure returns before include traversal. The existing check does not inspect the process return or the global last error. Copy and reader operations occur after this check.
